Plan the details

Good to know

Before you order.

Contact Relevant↗
What size banner should I order?

Start with a photo and approximate width of the display space, plus the distance from which people will read it. We can discuss a suitable size.

Can you design the banner?

Yes. Bring a logo, photos, and the exact words you need. We can prepare artwork and a proof for review.

How should I send my banner request?

Include the event or business name, exact text, size or location photo, quantity, desired finishing, and deadline.

What can we
make for you?

Tell us what you need, how many, and when you need it. We’ll help you work out the details.
